data.name: forceChangeSecCode
data.value:
Your security and privacy are extremely important to us. Therefore, we continuously strive to improve our security precautions to protect your data. For this reason, we have decided to implement a new feature called Security Code. It may be considered as a second password and will require you to input when you execute any sensitive actions such as change password, reopen/unsuspend accounts, etc.
Please use the form below to set your Security Code now.

data.name: informSecCode
data.value: Please input your security code before proceeding!

data.name: lblRequiredSecCode
data.value:
Security Code (SC) must be:

  • * Numeric digits only.
  • * 6 digits from 0-9.
  • * At least 2 different digits in the SC.
  • * Not a forward run AND not a backward run number:
    • + A "Forward Run" number is an integer whose digits are all in consecutive, ascending order, left to right.
    • + A "Backward Run" number is an integer whose digits are all in consecutive, descending order, left to right.
    • + For example: 123456, 456789, 765432, etc. are not allowed.
